generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Erection of fabricated exhibition stalls and other activities for National Agri Startup Expo 2026 to be held at UAS Dharwad campus (for two days period)

itemList.description: Exhibition Stall Setup: Erection of Aluminium-Framed Exhibition Stalls (6 ft X 6 ft Each) Including Weatherproof Ceiling/ Covering/ Geman Tent for Outdoor Exhibition Stalls, Two Chairs/ Per Stall

LED Screen Setup with Risers:  LED Screen - 10 ft X 10 ft, with Riser - 03 No. Providing and Installation of Left and Right Banner Wings Alongside the Stage LED Screen, with Black Cloth Masking, as per LED Screen Dimensions. For 2 days
Sound System Arrangements: Providing Sound System Setup (6 Units) for Entrance and Walkway Areas - Public Announcements and Background Music. For 2 days
Entrance and Walkway Matting: Providing and Laying of Red Matting along Exhibition Walkways and Entrance. Approx. area 5000 Sq.ft For 2 days
NASE-2026 3D Name Board 01 No: Fabrication and installation of the NASE-2026 3D letter-cut name board, with a 2 ft-high base and fabrication work make in  India lion ideal - 01 No For 2 days
Providing stainless steel (SS) tables For 2 days
Providing plastic chairs with covers. For 2 days
Providing round tables with white tablecloth covers. For 2 days

Selfie Stage Setup - Selfie stage measuring 10 ft X 10 ft X 1 ft in height. Two round high chairs. New red matting. Six golden - finish queue managers (stanchions). Branding banner measuring 10 ft X 10 ft. For 2 days
Venue Decoration: Designing and Execution of Creative Decorations Across the Event Venue, Including Entrance and Walkway Areas For 2 days Approx. area 200 Sq mtr
Entrance Branding Box Arch: Designing, fabrication and installation of an entrance branding box arch measuring 24 ft (W) X 14 ft (H), with a box frame of 2/3 ft X 2/3 ft. For 2 days

Housekeeping and Sanitation Arrangements: Providing 10 housekeeping staff/labourers for cleaning and maintaining exhibition stalls, walkways and toilets, ensuring proper hygiene throughout the event, along with 20 large-capacity dustbins for waste collection and disposal. For 2 days
Shamiyana weather proof  30 ft X 20 ft For 2 days
